tasks.title: Route takeoff measurements to trades at the seam
tasks.notes: Every measurement collapses to one anonymous kind=custom $0 line (TakeoffEstimateSeeder). Preserve+switch on kind: area(SF)→flooring, derived wall SF→painting, line(LF)→wall-linear/trim, count(EA)→doors/tile. Tag each line with a trade via core-vs-subbed helper. Files: TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php.

prep.what: Wire the seeder to route each measurement by kind to the right trade — flooring, painting, trim, doors, tile — instead of collapsing everything into one anonymous custom line.
prep.understand: Today `TakeoffEstimateSeeder` drops measurement kind and geometry, producing one `kind=custom $0` line. The routing fix switches on kind: `area(SF)`→flooring, derived wall SF→painting, `line(LF)`→wall-linear/trim, `count(EA)`→doors/tile. Rafa's ask: 'quanto de tile, quanto de trim, quanto de tudo' — this delivers it.
approach: Open `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` and trace how measurement rows are built today — find where kind is dropped
Add a `kind` switch routing each measurement kind to the correct trade constant
Tag each seeded line with a trade using the existing core-vs-subbed helper (grep for it)
Run against a test sheet and confirm each kind routes correctly — no quantity should be lost
resources: core-vs-subbed trade helper (grep codebase for `coreVsSubbed` or `trade_type`)
Measurement kind enum values (grep for `kind=` or `MeasurementKind`)
t45 output (wall paint SF line) — will be one of the routed kinds

tasks.title: Add PerLinearFt RateType (prerequisite for pricing trim/wall-linear)
tasks.notes: RateType enum has no per-linear-foot. Add PerLinearFt='per_linear_ft' + label, wire LineItemFactory::unitFromRateType->'lf', seed a per-LF trim LaborRate. Must land before takeoff pricing. Files: app/Enums/RateType.php, LineItemFactory.php, LaborRateSeeder.php.

prep.what: Add PerLinearFt to the RateType enum and wire it through the factory and seeder — prerequisite for pricing trim and wall-linear takeoff lines.
prep.understand: The `RateType` enum has no per-linear-foot variant, so trim lines (LF) from t46 can't be priced yet. This is a small but gating change: enum value → factory unit → labor rate seed. Must land before takeoff pricing (t48) can handle linear measurements.
approach: Add `PerLinearFt = 'per_linear_ft'` with a display label to `app/Enums/RateType.php`
Wire `'lf'` as the unit output in `LineItemFactory::unitFromRateType` for the new variant
Add a per-LF trim `LaborRate` entry to `LaborRateSeeder.php` (follow the existing per-SF pattern)
Run seeders and confirm a trim line priced per LF appears correctly in the estimate view
resources: Existing PerSqFt/PerUnit rate type entries as reference pattern
